listing.name: World Driver Championship — worlddriverchampionship-recomp (alondero)
listing.summary: Upstream Windows x64/Direct3D12 tests cover intro, menus and Hawaii practice driving: acceleration, steering, automatic gears and pause/resume. This remains an early development build with rendering glitches and experimental SDL audio. The frontend-enabled player now advertises rumble alongside persistent Controller Pak saves on port1, with strength in General settings; physical controller compatibility and feel remain unverified. Linux/Android are unvalidated. No Portcove build, save, controller, audio or gameplay qualification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own USA ROM; exact revision/hash must be resolved from title profile

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Source build.ps1 with the player own USA ROM, then play.ps1. No published player package is established by this README.
